I will modify the `DoubleConv` blocks within the U-Net architecture to include residual connections, transforming them into residual blocks. This structural enhancement improves gradient flow through the network layers, allowing the model to learn identity mappings more effectively and stabilize training for deeper representations. By preserving feature information across the convolution layers, the network can better capture subtle noise patterns in the documents, potentially lowering the validation RMSE. All existing training hyperparameters, such as epochs, learning rate schedule, and loss function, will remain unchanged to strictly evaluate the architectural improvement.
